figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Metabolomic analysis of S. albidoflavus RKJM0023 from small scale (2 mL) solid cultures supplemented with Rha. (A) Key molecular
clusters (classical molecular network) generated by GNPS with clusters labeled based on GNPS database hits for the MS2 patterns of known
natural products or Rha-derived features contained within the cluster. (B) Clusters of interest (antimycins, rhamnolipids, and surugamides) and
two key unknown clusters.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. (A) Volcano plot of features from RKJM0023 mycelium inoculum Rha titration, comparing the −log 10 (p-value) (Dunn test) versus the
log 2 (fold change) of the peak area of each feature to the vehicle control. Media and Rha control-associated features were excluded from the
analysis. The vertical red bars represent log 2 fold changes = 0.6 or −0.6 and the horizontal bar represents Dunn’s test where the p-value = −log
10(0.05). Shape correlates to the treatment group, and the color represents significant downregulation (p-value > 0.05 and fold change > −0.06,
blue), upregulation (p-value > 0.05 and fold change > 0.06, red), and no significance (teal). (B) Ion identity molecular network of RKJM0023 Rha
titration (n = 6).
